title: Maker Space Visits No-Show Rate
dataSources: Club attendance (`club:attendance`), running-club sessions (`runningclub:session`), maker-space visits (`makerspace:visit`), book-club meetings (`bookclub:meeting`), community events (`community:event`).
app: Book-club attendance, running-club miles, maker-space visits, and general social-club participation logs streamed to Splunk HEC via forms, check-ins, and calendar exports.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=makerspace:visit
| stats count as rsvps sum(eval(if(attended="no",1,0))) as no_shows by site
| eval no_show_pct=round(100*no_shows/rsvps,1)
| sort - no_show_pct
description: Calculates where maker space visits plans are most likely to turn into no-shows.
value: No-show tracking helps reveal whether the issue is venue, timing, commitment level, or overbooking.
implementation: Write a simple `attended=yes/no` field during event logging or check-in capture.
visualization: Table of site values by no-show percentage.
grandmaExplanation: It totals where plans around maker space visits most often fall through.
